description: This source file defines CLI command implementation for configuring environment variables associated with installed agent packages in the AgentField control plane. It includes functions for interactive configuration, listing current settings, setting, and unsetting environment variables, along with helper methods for file I/O and metadata loading.

classes.name: PackageConfigManager
classes.description: Handles environment variable configuration for agent packages, including listing, setting, unsetting, and interactive configuration workflows.

methods.name: runConfigCommand
methods.description: Executes the main logic of the config command based on CLI flags and arguments, managing installation/packaging interactions.

methods.name: InteractiveConfig
methods.description: Runs an interactive CLI session for configuring environment variables for a specific package.

methods.name: promptForVariable
methods.description: Prompts the user for input for a specific environment variable, handling masking secrets and validation.

methods.name: ListConfig
methods.description: Displays the current environment variable configurations for a package.

methods.name: SetVariable
methods.description: Sets a specific environment variable for a package, validating input.

methods.name: UnsetVariable
methods.description: Removes an environment variable from a package.

methods.name: loadPackageMetadata
methods.description: Loads package metadata and path from installation registry.

methods.name: loadEnvFile
methods.description: Reads environment variables from the package's .env file.

methods.name: saveEnvFile
methods.description: Writes environment variables to the package's .env file, with quoting as needed.

methods.name: maskSecret
methods.description: Obscures a secret value for display purposes.
